newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 13.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivory Coast Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan is in Japan, leading delegation of businessmen in continuation of investment promotion tour of Asia. - Privatisation committee organises "Open Day" in Abidjan on December 29-31 to promote the advantages of privatisation, advertisement says. - Cost of Internet connect time to go down after signing of accord between Ivory Coast and the United States for an Internet gateway in Abidjan under so-called Leland initiative. LA VOIE - Bidders for privatisation of Ivorian state telephone company CI-TELCOM to submit final bids on December 16; offers to be opened in public on December 17, advertisement says. LE REPUBLICAIN - Race for the U.N.'s top job: former Ivorian prime minister Alassane Ouattara now mentioned as a possible candidate. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
